decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Reasons for Approval: It is considered that the development would comply with U.D.P. Policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development),  ENV-B.2.2. (Conservation Areas), and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations). The development would be compatible with the design of the main building, would not cause loss of amenity to neighbouring residential properties subject to the conditions which have been imposed, and would preserve and enhance the character of the Conservation Area.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the terrace is used.

Condition : 4 - The boundary walls to the terrace hereby approved shall be maintained as shown on the approved drawing, including glazing, and no alterations shall be made to them unless prior written approval is granted by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of second floor roof terrace to flat no 10 of approved planning permission ref 00527/41-43/P13 dated 29/09/03 for change of use from offices to 9 residential units.  (Grove Park Conservation Area)
